AI.title_translation: 医疗保健和社会福利中机器学习的社会技术挑战
AI.tldr: ML在医疗和社会福利中的应用面临社会技术挑战。本文提出了一个包含11个挑战的框架和过程模型，用于系统地分析和描述这些挑战在设计和使用中如何出现。
AI.motivation: 现有的研究将机器学习在医疗保健和社会福利中的社会技术挑战归咎于设计者社会理解的局限或固有的技术限制，缺乏对跨环境进行系统描述和比较的支持。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于定性田野调查、纵向部署研究回顾以及与医疗保健和社会福利从业者共同设计研讨会的框架。该框架包括：（1）沿ML赋能的护理路径组织的11种社会技术挑战的分类，以及（2）关于这些挑战在设计和使用中出现条件的面向过程的解释。
AI.result: 提出了一个概念化机器学习社会技术挑战的框架，该框架提供了精简的词汇和专注于实践的解释性视角。
AI.conclusion: 通过提供精简的词汇和专注于实践的解释性视角，这项工作支持对机器学习工具在现实世界护理交付中如何运作和失灵进行更精确的分析。
AI.translation: 医疗保健和社会福利中机器学习的社会技术挑战是机器学习工具的功能方式与护理实践结构之间的不匹配。虽然先前的研究已经记录了许多此类问题，但现有解释通常将其归因于设计者有限的社会理解或固有的技术限制，为跨环境的系统描述和比较提供的支持有限。在本文中，我们提出了一个用于概念化机器学习社会技术挑战的框架，该框架基于定性田野调查、纵向部署研究回顾以及与医疗保健和社会福利从业者的共同设计研讨会。该框架包括（1）沿着ML赋能的护理路径组织的11种社会技术挑战的分类，以及（2）关于这些挑战在设计和使用中出现条件的面向过程的解释。通过提供精简的词汇和专注于实践的解释性视角，这项工作支持对机器学习工具在现实世界护理交付中如何运作和失灵进行更精确的分析。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个用于系统描述和比较机器学习在医疗保健和社会福利中社会技术挑战的框架。这些挑战被定义为ML工具功能与护理实践结构之间的不匹配。该框架基于定性研究和共设计研讨会，包含11类挑战和一套过程模型，旨在为分析ML工具在现实世界中的运作和失灵提供精确的词汇和实践视角。
AI.keywords: 机器学习, 社会技术挑战, 医疗保健, 社会福利, 框架
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于，它将对机器学习失败的解释从单纯归咎于技术或设计者意图转移到关注系统性不匹配（社会技术挑战）。通过提供一个结构化的、包含11个挑战的框架和过程模型，该工作为跨学科研究提供了一个共同的语言和分析工具，对于指导未来ML在敏感领域（如医疗和福利）的负责任设计和部署具有重要意义。

title: On the Virtual Network Embedding polytope
summary: We initiate the polyhedral study of the Virtual Network Embedding (VNE) problem, which arises in modern telecommunication networks. We propose new valid inequalities for the so-called flow formulation. We then prove, through a dedicated flow decomposition algorithm, that these inequalities characterize the VNE polytope in the case of an embedding of a virtual edge on a substrate path. Preliminary experiments show that the new inequalities propose promising speedups for MIP solvers.

AI.title_translation: 关于虚拟网络嵌入多面体
AI.tldr: 研究了虚拟网络嵌入（VNE）问题的多面体结构，提出了新的有效不等式，并证明了其在特定情况下的刻画能力，实验显示能加速MIP求解器。
AI.motivation: 虚拟网络嵌入（VNE）问题是现代电信网络中的关键问题，需要对其进行多面体研究以改进求解效率和理解其结构。
AI.method: 启动了VNE问题的多面体研究，针对流公式提出了新的有效不等式，并使用专用的流分解算法证明了这些不等式在虚拟边嵌入到底层路径情况下的多面体刻画能力。
AI.result: 证明了新提出的有效不等式在虚拟边嵌入到底层路径的特定情况下能够刻画VNE多面体。初步实验显示，新的不等式为MIP求解器带来了有前景的加速。
AI.conclusion: 新提出的有效不等式成功地对VNE多面体进行了部分刻画，并为使用MIP求解器解决VNE问题提供了显著的性能改进。
AI.translation: 我们发起了对虚拟网络嵌入（VNE）问题的多面体研究，该问题出现在现代电信网络中。我们针对所谓的流公式提出了新的有效不等式。随后，我们通过一个专用的流分解算法证明了，在将虚拟边嵌入到底层路径的情况下，这些不等式能够刻画VNE多面体。初步实验表明，新的不等式为MIP求解器带来了有前景的加速。
AI.summary: 本文首次对虚拟网络嵌入（VNE）问题进行了多面体研究。作者提出了针对VNE流公式的新型有效不等式，并利用流分解算法证明了它们在虚拟边嵌入特定底层路径时的多面体刻画能力。初步实验结果证实，这些不等式能显著加快混合整数规划（MIP）求解器的计算速度。
AI.keywords: 虚拟网络嵌入, 多面体, 有效不等式, 流公式, MIP求解器
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次将多面体理论应用于虚拟网络嵌入（VNE）问题，这是对该领域基础理论的重要贡献。通过引入新的有效不等式并证明其在特定简化情况下的精确刻画能力，为VNE的精确求解奠定了基础。实验结果进一步验证了这种理论工作在实际中带来的价值，即为混合整数规划（MIP）求解器提供了显著的加速，具有重要的实践意义。

title: The Great March 100: 100 Detail-oriented Tasks for Evaluating Embodied AI Agents
summary: Recently, with the rapid development of robot learning and imitation learning, numerous datasets and methods have emerged. However, these datasets and their task designs often lack systematic consideration and principles. This raises important questions: Do the current datasets and task designs truly advance the capabilities of robotic agents? Do evaluations on a few common tasks accurately reflect the differentiated performance of various methods proposed by different teams and evaluated on different tasks? To address these issues, we introduce the Great March 100 (\textbf{GM-100}) as the first step towards a robot learning Olympics. GM-100 consists of 100 carefully designed tasks that cover a wide range of interactions and long-tail behaviors, aiming to provide a diverse and challenging set of tasks to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of robotic agents and promote diversity and complexity in robot dataset task designs. These tasks are developed through systematic analysis and expansion of existing task designs, combined with insights from human-object interaction primitives and object affordances. We collect a large amount of trajectory data on different robotic platforms and evaluate several baseline models. Experimental results demonstrate that the GM-100 tasks are 1) feasible to execute and 2) sufficiently challenging to effectively differentiate the performance of current VLA models. Our data and code are available at https://rhos.ai/research/gm-100.

AI.title_translation: 伟大的长征100：用于评估具身AI智能体的100项注重细节的任务
AI.tldr: 针对现有机器人学习数据集缺乏系统性和区分度的问题，本文提出了GM-100，一个包含100项注重细节的挑战性任务集，旨在全面评估具身AI智能体（特别是VLA模型）的能力并有效区分它们的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人学习数据集及其任务设计缺乏系统性的考虑和原则。作者质疑现有数据集是否真正提升了机器人智能体的能力，以及对少数通用任务的评估能否准确反映不同方法之间的差异化性能。
AI.method: 引入“伟大的长征100”（GM-100），包含100项精心设计的任务，涵盖广泛的交互和长尾行为。这些任务通过系统分析、扩展现有任务设计，并结合人-物交互原语和物体功能性（affordances）的见解开发。同时收集了大量不同机器人平台的轨迹数据，并评估了几种基线模型。
AI.result: 实验结果证明，GM-100中的任务是1) 可执行的（feasible），并且 2) 具有足够的挑战性，能够有效区分当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: GM-100成功提供了一个多样化且具有挑战性的任务集，能够有效区分现有视觉-语言-动作模型的性能，并为机器人学习数据集的设计提供了更系统、更复杂的方向。
AI.translation: 最近，随着机器人学习和模仿学习的快速发展，涌现出大量数据集和方法。然而，这些数据集及其任务设计往往缺乏系统性的考虑和原则。这引出了重要的问题：当前的数据集和任务设计是否真正提升了机器人智能体的能力？对少数通用任务的评估是否准确反映了不同团队提出的、在不同任务上评估的各种方法之间的差异化性能？为了解决这些问题，我们引入了“伟大的长征100”（GM-100），作为迈向机器人学习奥林匹克的第一步。GM-100由100项精心设计的任务组成，涵盖了广泛的交互和长尾行为，旨在提供一个多样化且具有挑战性的任务集，以全面评估机器人智能体的能力，并促进机器人数据集任务设计的多样性和复杂性。这些任务是通过系统分析和扩展现有任务设计，结合人-物交互原语和物体功能性（affordances）的见解开发的。我们收集了大量不同机器人平台的轨迹数据，并评估了几种基线模型。实验结果表明，GM-100任务是 1) 可执行的，并且 2) 具有足够的挑战性，能够有效区分当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的性能。我们的数据和代码可在 https://rhos.ai/research/gm-100 获取。
AI.summary: 针对现有具身AI数据集和任务设计缺乏系统性和区分度的问题，本文提出了“伟大的长征100”（GM-100），这是一个包含100项精心设计、注重细节的任务集。GM-100涵盖了广泛的交互和长尾行为，旨在提供一个多样化且具有挑战性的任务集，以全面评估机器人智能体的能力，并推动机器人数据集任务设计的多样性和复杂性。实验证明该任务集可行且能有效区分当前VLA模型的性能。
AI.keywords: 具身AI, 评估, 数据集, 注重细节的任务, VLA模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于系统性地设计了100项注重细节的任务（GM-100），突破了现有数据集任务设计缺乏原则和区分度的问题。GM-100作为迈向“机器人学习奥林匹克”的第一步，其重要性在于提供了一个标准化、多样化且具有足够挑战性的基准，能够有效区分当前先进的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型性能，从而促进具身AI领域任务设计的多样性和复杂性。

title: PubMed-OCR: PMC Open Access OCR Annotations
summary: PubMed-OCR is an OCR-centric corpus of scientific articles derived from PubMed Central Open Access PDFs. Each page image is annotated with Google Cloud Vision and released in a compact JSON schema with word-, line-, and paragraph-level bounding boxes. The corpus spans 209.5K articles (1.5M pages; ~1.3B words) and supports layout-aware modeling, coordinate-grounded QA, and evaluation of OCR-dependent pipelines. We analyze corpus characteristics (e.g., journal coverage and detected layout features) and discuss limitations, including reliance on a single OCR engine and heuristic line reconstruction. We release the data and schema to facilitate downstream research and invite extensions.

AI.tldr: PubMed-OCR是一个包含20.95万科学文章的OCR语料库，通过Google Cloud Vision标注，支持布局感知建模和OCR相关管道评估。
AI.motivation: 该论文旨在通过构建一个大规模的OCR语料库来支持布局感知建模、坐标定位问答以及OCR依赖管道的评估，并促进下游研究。
AI.method: 该语料库通过从PubMed Central开放获取PDF中提取科学文章构建，每页图像都使用Google Cloud Vision进行标注，并以紧凑的JSON模式发布，包含单词、行和段落级别的边界框。
AI.result: 构建了一个包含20.95万篇文章（150万页；约13亿单词）的OCR语料库，并分析了语料库特征，如期刊覆盖率和检测到的布局特征。
AI.conclusion: 该论文发布了PubMed-OCR数据和模式，以促进下游研究和扩展，并讨论了语料库的局限性，包括对单一OCR引擎的依赖和启发式行重建。
AI.translation: PubMed-OCR是一个以OCR为中心的科学文章语料库，来源于PubMed Central开放获取PDF。每页图像都使用Google Cloud Vision进行标注，并以紧凑的JSON模式发布，包含单词、行和段落级别的边界框。该语料库涵盖20.95万篇文章（150万页；约13亿单词），支持布局感知建模、坐标定位问答以及OCR依赖管道的评估。我们分析了语料库特征（例如，期刊覆盖率和检测到的布局特征），并讨论了局限性，包括对单一OCR引擎的依赖和启发式行重建。我们发布了数据和模式，以促进下游研究并邀请扩展。
AI.summary: PubMed-OCR是一个基于PubMed Central开放获取PDF构建的大型OCR科学文章语料库，包含20.95万篇文章，通过Google Cloud Vision进行单词、行和段落级别的边界框标注。它旨在支持布局感知建模、坐标定位问答和OCR相关管道的评估。该论文分析了语料库特性并讨论了其局限性，并发布数据以促进进一步研究。
AI.keywords: PubMed-OCR, OCR, 语料库, 科学文章, Google Cloud Vision
AI.comments: 该论文通过发布一个大规模的、结构化的OCR标注语料库（PubMed-OCR），为科学文献分析领域做出了重要贡献。其创新之处在于提供了单词、行和段落级别的边界框，这对于布局感知建模和坐标定位问答至关重要。尽管存在依赖单一OCR引擎和启发式行重建的局限性，但该语料库的发布将极大地促进OCR相关研究和应用的发展。

title: Learning-Based Shrinking Disturbance-Invariant Tubes for State- and Input-Dependent Uncertainty
summary: We develop a learning-based framework for constructing shrinking disturbance-invariant tubes under state- and input-dependent uncertainty, intended as a building block for tube Model Predictive Control (MPC), and certify safety via a lifted, isotone (order-preserving) fixed-point map. Gaussian Process (GP) posteriors become $(1-α)$ credible ellipsoids, then polytopic outer sets for deterministic set operations. A two-time-scale scheme separates learning epochs, where these polytopes are frozen, from an inner, outside-in iteration that converges to a compact fixed point $Z^\star\!\subseteq\!\mathcal G$; its state projection is RPI for the plant. As data accumulate, disturbance polytopes tighten, and the associated tubes nest monotonically, resolving the circular dependence between the set to be verified and the disturbance model while preserving hard constraints. A double-integrator study illustrates shrinking tube cross-sections in data-rich regions while maintaining invariance.

AI.title_translation: 基于学习的、用于状态和输入依赖不确定性的收缩扰动不变管
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于学习（高斯过程）的框架，用于构建收缩的扰动不变管，作为管式MPC的构建模块。随着数据积累，管会单调收紧，同时通过不动点映射保证了安全性。
AI.motivation: 开发一个基于学习的框架，用于构建收缩扰动不变管，以作为管式模型预测控制（MPC）的基础构建模块，并处理依赖于状态和输入的不确定性。
AI.method: 采用基于学习的框架，通过提升的、保序（同调）不动点映射来证明安全性。具体方法包括：将高斯过程（GP）后验转换为 $(1-\alpha)$ 可信椭球，然后转换为确定性集合操作的多面体外集。使用双时间尺度方案：外部是学习周期（多面体冻结），内部是向内收敛到紧凑不动点 $Z^\star$ 的迭代。
AI.result: 通过双积分器研究进行了说明，展示了在数据丰富的区域中，管的横截面会收缩，同时保持不变性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功地构建了基于学习的、收缩的扰动不变管，解决了待验证集合与扰动模型之间的循环依赖关系，并保留了硬约束。
AI.translation: 我们开发了一个基于学习的框架，用于在状态和输入依赖不确定性下构建收缩扰动不变管，旨在作为管式模型预测控制（MPC）的基础构建模块，并通过提升的、保序（同调）不动点映射来认证安全性。高斯过程（GP）后验成为 $(1-\alpha)$ 可信椭球，然后成为用于确定性集合操作的多面体外集。双时间尺度方案将学习周期（在此期间多面体被冻结）与内部的、由外向内的迭代过程分开，该迭代收敛到一个紧凑的不动点 $Z^\star \subseteq \mathcal{G}$；其状态投影对于系统来说是鲁棒正不变（RPI）的。随着数据的积累，扰动多面体收紧，相关的管单调嵌套，解决了待验证集合与扰动模型之间的循环依赖关系，同时保留了硬约束。一项双积分器研究说明了在数据丰富的区域中管横截面的收缩，同时保持了不变性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于学习的框架，用于在状态和输入依赖不确定性下构建收缩扰动不变管，旨在作为管式模型预测控制（MPC）的基础组件。该方法通过提升的、保序不动点映射来认证系统的安全性。具体而言，它将高斯过程后验转换为多面体外集，并通过双时间尺度方案管理学习和迭代。随着数据积累，扰动多面体收紧，管会单调嵌套，成功解决了待验证集合与扰动模型之间的循环依赖性，并保持了硬约束。
AI.keywords: 基于学习, 扰动不变管, 模型预测控制, 高斯过程, 不确定性
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将高斯过程（GP）学习与形式化安全认证（通过保序不动点映射）相结合，以构建能够收缩的扰动不变管。这种方法的重要性在于它允许控制器的保守性随着数据积累而降低（管变紧），这优于传统的静态鲁棒控制设计。同时，双时间尺度方案和单调嵌套特性成功解决了自适应鲁棒控制中常见的集合验证与扰动模型之间的循环依赖难题。

title: Isotropy-Optimized Contrastive Learning for Semantic Course Recommendation
summary: This paper presents a semantic course recommendation system for students using a self-supervised contrastive learning approach built upon BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers). Traditional BERT embeddings suffer from anisotropic representation spaces, where course descriptions exhibit high cosine similarities regardless of semantic relevance. To address this limitation, we propose a contrastive learning framework with data augmentation and isotropy regularization that produces more discriminative embeddings. Our system processes student text queries and recommends Top-N relevant courses from a curated dataset of over 500 engineering courses across multiple faculties. Experimental results demonstrate that our fine-tuned model achieves improved embedding separation and more accurate course recommendations compared to vanilla BERT baselines.

AI.title_translation: 各向同性优化对比学习用于语义课程推荐
AI.tldr: 使用对比学习和各向同性正则化来优化BERT模型，解决了其在课程推荐中表示空间各向异性的问题，从而提高了推荐的准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统的BERT嵌入存在表示空间各向异性问题，导致课程描述即使在语义不相关的情况下也具有较高的余弦相似度，影响了语义课程推荐的准确性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于BERT的自监督对比学习框架，该框架结合了数据增强和各向同性正则化，以生成更具区分性的嵌入。该系统处理学生的文本查询，并推荐Top-N相关课程。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该微调模型与原始BERT基线相比，实现了改进的嵌入分离和更准确的课程推荐。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种语义课程推荐系统，该系统利用建立在BERT（来自Transformer的双向编码器表示）基础上的自监督对比学习方法为学生提供服务。传统的BERT嵌入存在表示空间各向异性的问题，即课程描述无论语义相关性如何，都表现出较高的余弦相似度。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种结合数据增强和各向同性正则化的对比学习框架，以生成更具区分性的嵌入。我们的系统处理学生的文本查询，并从一个包含多个学院的500多门工程课程的精选数据集中推荐Top-N相关课程。实验结果表明，与原始BERT基线相比，我们微调的模型实现了改进的嵌入分离和更准确的课程推荐。
AI.summary: 本研究针对BERT嵌入在语义课程推荐中存在的表示空间各向异性问题，提出了一种各向同性优化的自监督对比学习框架。该框架结合数据增强和各向同性正则化，旨在为500多门工程课程生成更具区分性的语义嵌入。实验证明，该方法有效提高了嵌入分离度，并实现了比原始BERT基线更准确的Top-N课程推荐。
AI.keywords: 对比学习, 各向同性正则化, 语义课程推荐, BERT, 各向异性
AI.comments: 创新点在于将对比学习与各向同性正则化相结合，专门用于优化BERT在课程推荐任务中的表示空间。这直接解决了预训练语言模型（如BERT）在下游任务中常见的表示空间退化问题（各向异性）。重要性在于通过生成更具区分性的语义嵌入，显著提高了课程推荐的准确性和相关性。局限性可能在于其评估仅基于500多门工程课程的数据集，其泛化能力（如应用于非工程领域或更大规模的语料库）在摘要中未得到证实。

title: Forcing and Diagnosing Failure Modes of Fourier Neural Operators Across Diverse PDE Families
summary: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) have shown strong performance in learning solution maps of partial differential equations (PDEs), but their robustness under distribution shifts, long-horizon rollouts, and structural perturbations remains poorly understood. We present a systematic stress-testing framework that probes failure modes of FNOs across five qualitatively different PDE families: dispersive, elliptic, multi-scale fluid, financial, and chaotic systems. Rather than optimizing in-distribution accuracy, we design controlled stress tests--including parameter shifts, boundary or terminal condition changes, resolution extrapolation with spectral analysis, and iterative rollouts--to expose vulnerabilities such as spectral bias, compounding integration errors, and overfitting to restricted boundary regimes. Our large-scale evaluation (1{,}000 trained models) reveals that distribution shifts in parameters or boundary conditions can inflate errors by more than an order of magnitude, while resolution changes primarily concentrate error in high-frequency modes. Input perturbations generally do not amplify error, though worst-case scenarios (e.g., localized Poisson perturbations) remain challenging. These findings provide a comparative failure-mode atlas and actionable insights for improving robustness in operator learning.

AI.title_translation: 跨越不同偏微分方程族群的傅里叶神经算子失效模式的施加与诊断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个系统的压力测试框架，用于在五种不同的偏微分方程（PDE）族群上诊断傅里叶神经算子（FNOs）的失效模式。结果发现，参数或边界条件的分布偏移会使误差增加一个数量级以上，而分辨率变化主要导致高频误差。这些发现为提高算子学习的鲁棒性提供了可操作的见解。
AI.motivation: 傅里叶神经算子（FNOs）在学习偏微分方程（PDEs）的解映射方面表现出色，但其在分布偏移、长时域展开和结构扰动下的鲁棒性仍知之甚少。
AI.method: 提出了一个系统的压力测试框架，用于探测跨越五种不同PDE族群（色散、椭圆、多尺度流体、金融和混沌系统）的FNO失效模式。该方法设计了受控的压力测试（包括参数偏移、边界或终端条件变化、利用谱分析进行分辨率外推、以及迭代展开），以暴露谱偏差、复合积分误差和对受限边界机制的过拟合等漏洞。研究涉及了1000个训练模型的大规模评估。
AI.result: 大规模评估（1000个训练模型）揭示了：1. 参数或边界条件的分布偏移可使误差膨胀一个数量级以上。2. 分辨率变化主要将误差集中在高频模式中。3. 输入扰动通常不会放大误差，但最坏情况的场景（如局部泊松扰动）仍然具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现提供了一个比较性的失效模式图谱，并为提高算子学习中的鲁棒性提供了可操作的见解。
AI.translation: 傅里叶神经算子（FNOs）在学习偏微分方程（PDEs）的解映射方面表现出强大的性能，但其在分布偏移、长时域展开和结构扰动下的鲁棒性仍知之甚少。我们提出了一个系统的压力测试框架，用于探测跨越五种性质不同的PDE族群：色散、椭圆、多尺度流体、金融和混沌系统的FNO失效模式。我们没有优化分布内精度，而是设计了受控的压力测试——包括参数偏移、边界或终端条件变化、利用谱分析进行分辨率外推以及迭代展开——以暴露诸如谱偏差、复合积分误差以及对受限边界机制的过拟合等漏洞。我们的大规模评估（1000个训练模型）揭示，参数或边界条件的分布偏移可使误差膨胀一个数量级以上，而分辨率变化主要将误差集中在高频模式中。输入扰动通常不会放大误差，尽管最坏情况的场景（例如局部泊松扰动）仍然具有挑战性。这些发现提供了一个比较性的失效模式图谱，并为提高算子学习中的鲁棒性提供了可操作的见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个系统的压力测试框架，用于评估傅里叶神经算子（FNOs）在五种不同偏微分方程（PDE）族群下的鲁棒性和失效模式。通过设计参数偏移、边界条件变化和分辨率外推等受控测试，研究暴露了FNOs在分布偏移下的显著误差膨胀（超过一个数量级），以及分辨率变化导致的误差主要集中在高频模式。研究结果形成了一个失效模式图谱，为提升算子学习的鲁棒性提供了关键指导。
AI.keywords: 傅里叶神经算子, 偏微分方程, 鲁棒性, 失效模式, 分布偏移
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于其系统性和大规模的诊断方法。它没有简单地报告最优性能，而是专注于通过设计“压力测试”来主动暴露模型在实际应用中可能遇到的关键弱点，例如分布偏移和泛化到不同分辨率的能力。通过跨越五种性质迥异的PDE族群（从色散到混沌系统）进行测试，该研究提供了关于FNOs鲁棒性的全面图景。特别是关于误差在高频模式中的集中以及参数偏移导致误差数量级增加的发现，对未来设计更具鲁棒性的神经算子架构和训练策略具有重要的指导意义。

title: Relational Linearity is a Predictor of Hallucinations
summary: Hallucination is a central failure mode in large language models (LLMs). We focus on hallucinations of answers to questions like: "Which instrument did Glenn Gould play?", but we ask these questions for synthetic entities that are unknown to the model. Surprisingly, we find that medium-size models like Gemma-7B-IT frequently hallucinate, i.e., they have difficulty recognizing that the hallucinated fact is not part of their knowledge. We hypothesize that an important factor in causing these hallucinations is the linearity of the relation: linear relations tend to be stored more abstractly, making it difficult for the LLM to assess its knowledge; the facts of nonlinear relations tend to be stored more directly, making knowledge assessment easier. To investigate this hypothesis, we create SyntHal, a dataset of 6000 synthetic entities for six relations. In our experiments with four models, we determine, for each relation, the hallucination rate on SyntHal and also measure its linearity, using $Δ\cos$. We find a strong correlation ($r \in [.78,.82]$) between relational linearity and hallucination rate, providing evidence for our hypothesis that the underlying storage of triples of a relation is a factor in how well a model can self-assess its knowledge. This finding has implications for how to manage hallucination behavior and suggests new research directions for improving the representation of factual knowledge in LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 关系线性度是幻觉的一个预测指标
AI.tldr: 大语言模型中，关系（如事实知识）的线性度越高，模型产生幻觉的倾向性就越大，这与知识的抽象存储方式有关。
AI.motivation: 幻觉是大语言模型（LLMs）的一个核心故障模式，尤其是在回答模型知识库中不存在的合成实体问题时。作者假设关系（事实）的线性度是导致幻觉的重要因素。
AI.method: 创建了包含六种关系的6000个合成实体数据集SyntHal。使用SyntHal在四种模型上测试了每种关系的幻觉率，并使用$Δ\cos$来衡量关系的线性度。
AI.result: 发现关系线性度与幻觉率之间存在强相关性（相关系数$r \in [.78,.82]$）。中型模型（如Gemma-7B-IT）在处理合成实体时经常产生幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 关系三元组的底层存储是影响模型自我评估知识能力的一个因素。这一发现为管理幻觉行为和改进LLM中事实知识的表示提供了新的研究方向。
AI.translation: 幻觉是大语言模型（LLMs）的一个核心故障模式。我们关注的是对类似“Glenn Gould演奏了哪种乐器？”这类问题的答案幻觉，但我们对模型未知的合成实体提出了这些问题。令人惊讶的是，我们发现像Gemma-7B-IT这样的中型模型经常产生幻觉，即它们难以识别幻觉的事实是否属于其知识的一部分。我们假设，导致这些幻觉的一个重要因素是关系的线性度：线性关系倾向于更抽象地存储，这使得LLM难以评估其知识；非线性关系的事实倾向于更直接地存储，从而使知识评估更容易。为了验证这一假设，我们创建了SyntHal，这是一个包含六种关系的6000个合成实体的数据集。在我们对四种模型的实验中，我们确定了每种关系在SyntHal上的幻觉率，并使用$Δ\cos$测量了其线性度。我们发现关系线性度与幻觉率之间存在强相关性（相关系数$r \in [.78,.82]$），为我们的假设提供了证据，即关系三元组的底层存储是影响模型自我评估知识能力的一个因素。这一发现对如何管理幻觉行为具有启示意义，并为改进LLM中事实知识的表示提出了新的研究方向。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了大语言模型（LLMs）中幻觉产生的原因，特别是针对合成实体的提问。研究提出并验证了一个核心假设：关系（事实知识）的线性度是幻觉的关键预测指标。通过创建数据集SyntHal并测试四种模型，作者发现关系线性度越高，幻觉率越高，二者呈强相关性（$r \in [.78,.82]$）。研究认为，线性关系倾向于抽象存储，阻碍了模型进行知识自我评估，而非线性关系倾向于直接存储，有助于知识评估。这一发现为解决LLM的幻觉问题和改进知识表示提供了理论基础。
AI.keywords: 幻觉, 关系线性度, 大语言模型, 知识评估, SyntHal
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了“关系线性度”作为大语言模型幻觉的一个量化预测指标，并提供了存储机制上的解释（线性关系倾向于抽象存储，非线性关系倾向于直接存储）。这一发现对于理解LLM如何存储和检索事实知识至关重要，并为开发新的幻觉缓解策略指明了方向，例如通过调整知识表示方式来优化模型的自我知识评估能力。

title: A Practical Guide to Establishing Technical Debt Management
summary: This white paper provides an overview of the topic of "technical debt" and presents an approach for managing technical debt in teams. The white paper is based on the results of my dissertation, which aimed to translate scientific findings into practical guidance. To this end, I collaborated with other researchers to support three teams from different companies in adapting and establishing a technical debt management system tailored to their specific needs. Research findings were supplemented with details or additional approaches. Research results that were less practical were discarded. The result is a guide on establishing technical debt management within a team. The guide is intended to provide orientation and not be a rigid framework. We distinguish between "best practices" and "nice-to-haves." "Best practices" are understood to be all approaches that were adopted by all three teams. "Nice-to-haves" were used by at least one team. In many places, it is explicitly mentioned that the team should decide together how to design the process. This also applies, of course, to all areas where this was not explicitly mentioned. This white paper explicitly does not cover the establishment of technical debt management across the entire company, but provides suggestions for this at the end.

AI.title_translation: 建立技术债务管理的实用指南
AI.tldr: 本白皮书基于一项博士研究，通过与三家不同公司的团队合作，将科学发现转化为实用的技术债务管理指南。该指南侧重于团队层面，区分了“最佳实践”和“可选项”，强调灵活性和团队自主决策。
AI.motivation: 旨在将科学发现（博士论文研究成果）转化为实用的指导方针，为团队提供管理技术债务的方法和建立技术债务管理系统的实用指南。
AI.method: 作者基于其博士研究，与其他研究人员合作，支持来自不同公司的三个团队，根据他们的具体需求调整和建立技术债务管理系统。研究结果经过补充、筛选，并摒弃了不切实际的方法。该指南通过区分被所有团队采用的“最佳实践”和至少一个团队使用的“可选项”来组织内容。
AI.result: 形成了一份关于在团队内部建立技术债务管理的实用指南。该指南旨在提供方向，而非僵硬的框架，并区分了所有团队都采用的“最佳实践”和至少一个团队使用的“可选项”。
AI.conclusion: 该指南旨在提供指导和方向，而不是一个僵化的框架。团队应该共同决定如何设计流程。该指南主要关注团队层面的技术债务管理，对公司范围的推广仅在末尾提供建议。
AI.translation: 本白皮书概述了“技术债务”这一主题，并提出了一种在团队中管理技术债务的方法。本白皮书基于我的博士论文研究成果，旨在将科学发现转化为实用指导。为此，我与其他研究人员合作，支持来自不同公司的三个团队调整和建立适合他们特定需求的技术债务管理系统。研究结果得到了细节补充或其他方法的充实，不切实际的研究结果被摒弃。最终形成了一份关于在团队内部建立技术债务管理的指南。该指南旨在提供方向，而非僵化的框架。我们区分了“最佳实践”和“可选项”。“最佳实践”被理解为所有三个团队都采用的方法。“可选项”则至少被一个团队使用。在许多地方，都明确提到团队应该共同决定如何设计流程。当然，这也适用于所有未明确提及的领域。本白皮书明确不涉及在整个公司范围内建立技术债务管理，但在结尾提供了相关建议。
AI.summary: 本白皮书基于一项博士研究，为团队建立技术债务管理（TD）系统提供了实用指南。作者通过与来自不同公司的三个团队合作，将科学发现转化为可操作的步骤，并对研究结果进行了筛选和补充。指南区分了被所有团队采纳的“最佳实践”和至少一个团队使用的“可选项”，强调其灵活性，旨在提供指导而非僵化框架，且明确指导范围仅限于团队层面。
AI.keywords: 技术债务管理, 实用指南, 团队管理, 最佳实践, 博士研究
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将学术研究（博士论文）与实际应用相结合，通过实地支持和观察三个不同团队建立技术债务管理（TD）系统的过程，确保了指南的实用性和可操作性。其重要性在于为软件工程领域提供了一个经过实践检验、非教条式的TD管理方法论，特别是通过区分“最佳实践”和“可选项”，允许团队根据自身需求进行定制。局限性在于其范围明确限制在团队层面，而非公司级部署，尽管它为后者提供了初步建议。

title: The unreasonable effectiveness of pattern matching
summary: We report on an astonishing ability of large language models (LLMs) to make sense of "Jabberwocky" language in which most or all content words have been randomly replaced by nonsense strings, e.g., translating "He dwushed a ghanc zawk" to "He dragged a spare chair". This result addresses ongoing controversies regarding how to best think of what LLMs are doing: are they a language mimic, a database, a blurry version of the Web? The ability of LLMs to recover meaning from structural patterns speaks to the unreasonable effectiveness of pattern-matching. Pattern-matching is not an alternative to "real" intelligence, but rather a key ingredient.

AI.title_translation: 模式匹配的非凡有效性
AI.tldr: LLM可以从乱码（Jabberwocky）语言中恢复意义，这表明模式匹配非常有效，并且是智能的关键部分，而不是替代品。
AI.motivation: 这项结果旨在解决关于如何最好地理解LLM行为的持续争议：它们是语言模仿者、数据库，还是网络的模糊版本。
AI.method: 报告了大型语言模型（LLMs）对“Jabberwocky”语言（其中大部分或全部内容词被随机替换为无意义的字符串）的理解能力。
AI.result: 大型语言模型（LLMs）表现出惊人的能力，能够理解“Jabberwocky”语言，例如将“He dwushed a ghanc zawk”翻译成“He dragged a spare chair”。
AI.conclusion: LLM从结构模式中恢复意义的能力证明了模式匹配的“不合理有效性”，并且模式匹配是“真正的”智能的一个关键组成部分。
AI.translation: 我们报告了大型语言模型（LLMs）在理解“Jabberwocky”语言方面的惊人能力，在这种语言中，大部分或全部内容词已被随机替换为无意义的字符串，例如将“He dwushed a ghanc zawk”翻译成“He dragged a spare chair”。这一结果解决了关于如何最好地理解LLM行为的持续争议：它们是语言模仿者、数据库，还是网络的模糊版本？LLM从结构模式中恢复意义的能力证明了模式匹配的“不合理有效性”。模式匹配不是“真正的”智能的替代品，而是其关键组成部分。
AI.summary: 研究报告了大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理内容词被替换的“Jabberwocky”语言时，表现出惊人的意义恢复能力，这证明了模式匹配在语言理解中的核心作用，并暗示模式匹配是“真实”智能的关键组成部分。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 模式匹配, Jabberwocky语言, 语言理解, 结构模式
AI.comments: 这项研究强调了LLM在处理结构化语言（如“Jabberwocky”语言）时的惊人能力，表明模式匹配在理解语言方面起着核心且“不合理有效”的作用。然而，它没有深入探讨这种能力背后的确切机制，也没有明确说明它与传统“真实”智能的关系。

title: Inter-patient ECG Arrhythmia Classification with LGNs and LUTNs
summary: Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (LGNs) and Lookup Table Networks (LUTNs) are demonstrated to be suitable for the automatic classification of electrocardiograms (ECGs) using the inter-patient paradigm. The methods are benchmarked using the MIT-BIH arrhythmia data set, achieving up to 94.28% accuracy and a $jκ$ index of 0.683 on a four-class classification problem. Our models use between 2.89k and 6.17k FLOPs, including preprocessing and readout, which is three to six orders of magnitude less compared to SOTA methods. A novel preprocessing method is utilized that attains superior performance compared to existing methods for both the mixed-patient and inter-patient paradigms. In addition, a novel method for training the Lookup Tables (LUTs) in LUTNs is devised that uses the Boolean equation of a multiplexer (MUX). Additionally, rate coding was utilized for the first time in these LGNs and LUTNs, enhancing the performance of LGNs. Furthermore, it is the first time that LGNs and LUTNs have been benchmarked on the MIT-BIH arrhythmia dataset using the inter-patient paradigm. Using an Artix 7 FPGA, between 2000 and 2990 LUTs were needed, and between 5 to 7 mW (i.e. 50 pJ to 70 pJ per inference) was estimated for running these models. The performance in terms of both accuracy and $jκ$-index is significantly higher compared to previous LGN results. These positive results suggest that one can utilize LGNs and LUTNs for the detection of arrhythmias at extremely low power and high speeds in heart implants or wearable devices, even for patients not included in the training set.

AI.title_translation: 基于LGN和LUTN的跨患者心律失常分类
AI.tldr: 本研究展示了深度可微逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）在跨患者心电图（ECG）心律失常分类中的适用性，达到了94.28%的准确率和0.683的jκ指数，同时计算量和功耗极低。研究还提出了一种新颖的预处理方法、一种训练LUT的方法以及首次在LGNs和LUTNs中使用率编码，显著提升了模型性能，并首次在MIT-BIH数据库的跨患者范式下进行了基准测试。
AI.motivation: 研究的动机在于探索在跨患者范式下，使用深度可微逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）进行心电图（ECG）心律失常分类的可行性，并旨在实现极低的计算量和功耗。
AI.method: 本研究采用了深度可微逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）进行ECG心律失常分类。具体方法包括：使用一种新颖的预处理方法，一种使用多路复用器（MUX）布尔方程训练查找表（LUT）的新方法，以及首次在LGNs和LUTNs中引入率编码。模型在MIT-BIH心律失常数据集上进行了跨患者范式的基准测试。
AI.result: 在四类分类问题中，LGNs和LUTNs模型达到了高达94.28%的准确率和0.683的jκ指数。模型的计算量（FLOPs）在2.89k到6.17k之间，比现有最先进方法低三到六个数量级。在FPGA上，模型仅需2000到2990个LUTs，功耗估计为5到7 mW。预处理方法在混合患者和跨患者范式下均优于现有方法。率编码提升了LGNs的性能。LGNs和LUTNs在跨患者范式下的性能显著优于之前的LGNs结果。
AI.conclusion: 深度可微逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）在跨患者心电图（ECG）心律失常分类任务中表现出色，实现了高准确率和极低的计算功耗。这些网络结合新颖的预处理、训练方法和率编码技术，为在心脏植入设备或可穿戴设备中实现超低功耗、高速的心律失常检测提供了有前景的解决方案，即使对于未包含在训练集中的患者也有效。
AI.translation: 深度可微逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）被证明适用于使用跨患者范例的自动心电图（ECG）分类。这些方法使用MIT-BIH心律失常数据集进行了基准测试，在四类分类问题上达到了高达94.28%的准确率和0.683的jκ指数。我们的模型使用了2.89k到6.17k的浮点运算次数（FLOPs），包括预处理和读出，与最先进的方法相比，计算量减少了三到六个数量级。采用了一种新颖的预处理方法，该方法在混合患者和跨患者范式下均优于现有方法。此外，还设计了一种使用多路复用器（MUX）布尔方程训练查找表（LUT）的新方法。此外，率编码首次用于这些LGNs和LUTNs，增强了LGNs的性能。此外，首次使用跨患者范式在MIT-BIH心律失常数据集上对LGNs和LUTNs进行了基准测试。使用Artix 7 FPGA，需要2000到2990个LUTs，并且估计运行这些模型需要5到7 mW（即每次推理50 pJ到70 pJ）。与之前的LGN结果相比，在准确率和jκ指数方面的性能都显著提高。这些积极的结果表明，可以在心脏植入设备或可穿戴设备中使用LGNs和LUTNs来检测心律失常，实现极低的功耗和高速度，即使对于未包含在训练集中的患者也有效。
AI.summary: 本研究探索了深度可微逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）在跨患者心电图（ECG）心律失常分类中的应用。研究提出了一种新颖的预处理方法、一种基于多路复用器布尔方程的LUT训练方法，并首次将率编码应用于LGNs和LUTNs，以提升性能。在MIT-BIH数据集上，该方法在跨患者范式下取得了94.28%的准确率和0.683的jκ指数，同时实现了极低的计算量（2.89k-6.17k FLOPs）和功耗（5-7 mW）。
AI.keywords: 心律失常分类, 深度可微逻辑门网络, 查找表网络, 跨患者学习, 低功耗
AI.comments: 该研究在心律失常分类领域取得了显著进展，特别是在跨患者学习和低功耗模型设计方面。新颖的预处理方法和LUT训练策略是亮点，而率编码的引入进一步提升了模型性能。该研究的低计算量和低功耗特性使其在资源受限的设备（如可穿戴设备和植入式医疗设备）中具有巨大的应用潜力。然而，未来研究可以进一步探讨模型的可解释性以及在更大规模、更多样化的数据集上的泛化能力。

title: GenDA: Generative Data Assimilation on Complex Urban Areas via Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
summary: Urban wind flow reconstruction is essential for assessing air quality, heat dispersion, and pedestrian comfort, yet remains challenging when only sparse sensor data are available. We propose GenDA, a generative data assimilation framework that reconstructs high-resolution wind fields on unstructured meshes from limited observations. The model employs a multiscale graph-based diffusion architecture trained on computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations and interprets classifier-free guidance as a learned posterior reconstruction mechanism: the unconditional branch learns a geometry-aware flow prior, while the sensor-conditioned branch injects observational constraints during sampling. This formulation enables obstacle-aware reconstruction and generalization across unseen geometries, wind directions, and mesh resolutions without retraining. We consider both sparse fixed sensors and trajectory-based observations using the same reconstruction procedure. When evaluated against supervised graph neural network (GNN) baselines and classical reduced-order data assimilation methods, GenDA reduces the relative root-mean-square error (RRMSE) by 25-57% and increases the structural similarity index (SSIM) by 23-33% across the tested meshes. Experiments are conducted on Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) simulations of a real urban neighbourhood in Bristol, United Kingdom, at a characteristic Reynolds number of $\mathrm{Re}\approx2\times10^{7}$, featuring complex building geometry and irregular terrain. The proposed framework provides a scalable path toward generative, geometry-aware data assimilation for environmental monitoring in complex domains.

AI.title_translation: 基于分类器自由扩散引导的复杂城市区域生成数据同化
AI.tldr: GenDA是一个新的生成数据同化框架，利用扩散模型从稀疏的传感器数据中重建高分辨率城市风场，在复杂几何形状下表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 城市风场重建对于空气质量评估至关重要，但稀疏传感器数据使得这一任务具有挑战性。
AI.method: GenDA使用多尺度图基扩散架构，结合计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟进行训练。它将分类器自由引导解释为一种学习到的后验重建机制，其中无条件分支学习几何感知流先验，有条件分支注入观测约束。
AI.result: 与监督GNN基线和经典降阶数据同化方法相比，GenDA将RRMSE降低了25-57%，SSIM提高了23-33%。
AI.conclusion: GenDA提供了一种可扩展的生成式、几何感知数据同化方法，用于复杂环境监测。
AI.translation: 城市风场重建对于评估空气质量、热量扩散和行人舒适度至关重要，但当只有稀疏的传感器数据可用时，这一任务仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了GenDA，一个生成式数据同化框架，可以从有限的观测中重建非结构化网格上的高分辨率风场。该模型采用多尺度图基扩散架构，在计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟上进行训练，并将分类器自由引导解释为一种学习到的后验重建机制：无条件分支学习几何感知流先验，而传感器条件分支在采样过程中注入观测约束。这种方法能够在不重新训练的情况下，实现对看不见的几何形状、风向和网格分辨率的障碍物感知重建和泛化。我们使用相同的重建程序处理稀疏固定传感器和基于轨迹的观测。与监督图神经网络（GNN）基线和经典降阶数据同化方法相比，GenDA在测试网格上的相对均方根误差（RRMSE）降低了25-57%，结构相似性指数（SSIM）提高了23-33%。实验在英国布里斯托真实城市街区的雷诺数约为$2 	imes 10^{7}$的雷诺平均纳维-斯托克斯（RANS）模拟上进行，该街区具有复杂的建筑几何形状和不规则的地形。所提出的框架为复杂领域中的环境监测提供了通往生成式、几何感知数据同化的可扩展路径。
AI.summary: GenDA是一个新颖的生成数据同化框架，它利用基于扩散模型的架构，能够从稀疏的传感器数据中重建复杂城市区域的高分辨率风场。该方法通过将分类器自由引导作为后验重建机制，实现了对几何形状、风向和网格分辨率的泛化能力，无需重新训练。在布里斯托的真实城市街区进行的实验表明，GenDA在减少重建误差和提高相似性方面显著优于现有的基线方法。
AI.keywords: 数据同化, 扩散模型, 城市风场, 机器学习, 计算流体动力学
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个创新的生成数据同化框架GenDA，利用扩散模型解决了城市风场重建的挑战。其主要优势在于能够从稀疏数据中进行高分辨率重建，并对复杂几何形状和不同条件具有良好的泛化能力。分类器自由引导作为后验重建机制的解释是一个有趣的视角。然而，CFD模拟的计算成本和GenDA训练的计算需求可能是实际应用中的潜在限制。该方法在环境监测领域具有重要意义。

title: Hierarchical Orthogonal Residual Spread for Precise Massive Editing in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional performance across various domains, yet they face critical safety concerns. Model editing has emerged as an effective approach to mitigate these issues. Existing model editing methods often focus on optimizing an information matrix that blends new and old knowledge. While effective, these approaches can be computationally expensive and may cause conflicts. In contrast, we shift our attention to Hierarchical Orthogonal Residual SprEad of the information matrix, which reduces noisy gradients and enables more stable edits from a different perspective. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method HORSE through a clear theoretical comparison with several popular methods and extensive experiments conducted on two datasets across multiple LLMs. The results show that HORSE maintains precise massive editing across diverse scenarios. The code is available at https://github.com/XiaojieGu/HORSE

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型中精确大规模编辑的分层正交残差传播
AI.tldr: HORSE是一种新的LLM编辑技术，它通过研究信息矩阵的残差传播来稳定和精确地修改模型，避免了现有方法的计算昂贵和知识冲突问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的模型编辑方法通常侧重于优化一个融合新旧知识的信息矩阵，但这可能导致计算成本高昂和知识冲突。需要一种新的方法来缓解这些问题。
AI.method: 我们提出了“信息矩阵的层次正交残差传播”（Hierarchical Orthogonal Residual SprEad of the information matrix），通过减少噪声梯度来实现更稳定的编辑。
AI.result: HORSE通过清晰的理论比较和在多个LLM的两个数据集上的广泛实验证明了其有效性，并保持了精确的大规模编辑能力。
AI.conclusion: HORSE在多种场景下保持了精确的大规模编辑能力。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在各种领域表现出卓越的性能，但它们面临着关键的安全问题。模型编辑已成为缓解这些问题的有效方法。现有的模型编辑方法通常侧重于优化一个融合新旧知识的信息矩阵。虽然有效，但这些方法计算成本可能很高，并且可能引起冲突。相比之下，我们将注意力转移到信息矩阵的层次正交残差传播（Hierarchical Orthogonal Residual SprEad），它从不同的角度减少了噪声梯度，并实现了更稳定的编辑。我们通过与几种流行方法的清晰理论比较以及在多个LLM的两个数据集上进行的广泛实验，证明了我们方法HORSE的有效性。结果表明，HORSE在各种场景下保持了精确的大规模编辑能力。代码可在https://github.com/XiaojieGu/HORSE获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为HORSE的新型大型语言模型编辑方法，它通过关注信息矩阵的层次正交残差传播来替代传统的优化信息矩阵融合方法，从而减少噪声梯度，实现更稳定和精确的大规模模型编辑。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 模型编辑, 正交残差传播, 信息矩阵, 稳定性
AI.comments: 该方法（HORSE）的创新点在于从信息矩阵的残差传播角度（而非传统的优化信息矩阵融合新旧知识）来减少噪声梯度，从而实现更稳定的编辑。其重要性在于能够在不显著增加计算成本的情况下，实现精确的大规模模型编辑。局限性可能在于其理论基础和实验验证的完整性，但根据摘要信息无法判断。

title: Map2Thought: Explicit 3D Spatial Reasoning via Metric Cognitive Maps
summary: We propose Map2Thought, a framework that enables explicit and interpretable spatial reasoning for 3D VLMs. The framework is grounded in two key components: Metric Cognitive Map (Metric-CogMap) and Cognitive Chain-of-Thought (Cog-CoT). Metric-CogMap provides a unified spatial representation by integrating a discrete grid for relational reasoning with a continuous, metric-scale representation for precise geometric understanding. Building upon the Metric-CogMap, Cog-CoT performs explicit geometric reasoning through deterministic operations, including vector operations, bounding-box distances, and occlusion-aware appearance order cues, producing interpretable inference traces grounded in 3D structure. Experimental results show that Map2Thought enables explainable 3D understanding, achieving 59.9% accuracy using only half the supervision, closely matching the 60.9% baseline trained with the full dataset. It consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 5.3%, 4.8%, and 4.0% under 10%, 25%, and 50% training subsets, respectively, on the VSI-Bench.

AI.title_translation: Map2Thought：通过度量认知地图实现的显式3D空间推理
AI.tldr: Map2Thought通过结合离散和连续表示的Metric-CogMap和基于几何操作的Cog-CoT，成功地使3D VLM具备了可解释的空间推理能力，并在效率和性能上超越了SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 为3D视觉语言模型（VLM）提供显式和可解释的空间推理能力。
AI.method: Map2Thought框架包含两个核心组件：Metric-CogMap，它统一了离散网格（用于关系推理）和连续度量尺度（用于几何理解）的3D空间表示；以及Cog-CoT，它在Metric-CogMap基础上执行显式的几何推理，包括向量运算、边界框距离和遮挡感知外观顺序线索。
AI.result: 在VSI-Bench上，Map2Thought使用仅一半的监督数据达到了59.9%的准确率，接近使用完整数据集训练的60.9%基线。与最先进方法相比，在10%、25%和50%的训练子集下，分别提高了5.3%、4.8%和4.0%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: Map2Thought框架通过Metric-CogMap和Cog-CoT，实现了可解释的3D理解，并在VSI-Bench上以更少的监督数据取得了与全监督基线相当的性能，同时在数据稀疏性下显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.translation: 我们提出了Map2Thought，一个能够为3D VLM实现显式和可解释的空间推理的框架。该框架基于两个关键组成部分：度量认知地图（Metric-CogMap）和认知链式思维（Cog-CoT）。Metric-CogMap通过整合用于关系推理的离散网格和用于精确几何理解的连续度量尺度表示，提供统一的空间表征。在Metric-CogMap的基础上，Cog-CoT通过确定性的操作（包括向量操作、边界框距离和遮挡感知的出现顺序线索）执行显式的几何推理，产生基于3D结构的、可解释的推理痕迹。实验结果表明，Map2Thought实现了可解释的3D理解，仅使用一半的监督数据就达到了59.9%的准确率，非常接近使用完整数据集训练的60.9%基线。它在VSI-Bench上，分别在10%、25%和50%的训练子集下，持续优于最先进的方法5.3%、4.8%和4.0%。
AI.summary: Map2Thought是一个为3D视觉语言模型设计的框架，旨在实现显式和可解释的空间推理。它通过引入度量认知地图（Metric-CogMap）提供统一的、兼顾离散关系和连续几何的3D表征，并通过认知链式思维（Cog-CoT）执行基于几何操作的推理。实验证明，该方法在数据效率和性能上均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 3D空间推理, 认知地图, 视觉语言模型, 度量表示, 可解释性
AI.comments: Map2Thought的创新点在于将离散的关系推理与连续的度量几何理解相结合，通过度量认知地图（Metric-CogMap）实现了3D视觉语言模型（VLM）中显式且可解释的空间推理。其在数据效率方面表现出色，仅使用一半的监督数据就能达到与全监督基线相当的性能。限制是，其性能的提升主要依赖于引入的特定几何推理操作（如向量运算和边界框距离），这些操作的有效性可能依赖于场景的性质。

title: Predict the Retrieval! Test time adaptation for Retrieval Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful approach for enhancing large language models' question-answering capabilities through the integration of external knowledge. However, when adapting RAG systems to specialized domains, challenges arise from distribution shifts, resulting in suboptimal generalization performance. In this work, we propose TTARAG, a test-time adaptation method that dynamically updates the language model's parameters during inference to improve RAG system performance in specialized domains. Our method introduces a simple yet effective approach where the model learns to predict retrieved content, enabling automatic parameter adjustment to the target domain. Through extensive experiments across six specialized domains, we demonstrate that TTARAG achieves substantial performance improvements over baseline RAG systems. Code available at https://github.com/sunxin000/TTARAG.

AI.title_translation: 预测检索内容！用于检索增强生成的测试时间适应
AI.tldr: 针对RAG系统在专业领域性能差的问题，我们提出了TTARAG，一种在测试时动态调整模型参数的方法，通过预测检索内容来实现领域适应，实验证明效果显著。
AI.motivation: 当RAG系统适应专业领域时，会出现分布偏移（distribution shifts）问题，导致泛化性能不佳。
AI.method: TTARAG，一种测试时间适应方法，通过使模型学会预测检索到的内容，从而在推理过程中动态更新语言模型的参数以适应目标领域。
AI.result: TTARAG 在六个专业领域实验中，相比基线RAG系统取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: TTARAG 通过在推理过程中动态更新语言模型参数，实现了对专业领域RAG系统的性能提升，并在六个专业领域实验中展示了相对于基线RAG系统的显著性能改进。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为一种强大的方法，通过整合外部知识来增强大型语言模型在问答方面的能力。然而，当将RAG系统适应到专业领域时，由于分布偏移而产生挑战，导致泛化性能不佳。在这项工作中，我们提出了TTARAG，一种测试时间适应方法，它在推理过程中动态更新语言模型的参数，以提高RAG系统在专业领域的性能。我们的方法引入了一种简单而有效的方法，即让模型学会预测检索到的内容，从而实现参数到目标领域的自动调整。通过在六个专业领域进行的广泛实验，我们证明了TTARAG相比基线RAG系统实现了显著的性能提升。代码可在https://github.com/sunxin000/TTARAG获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TTARAG，一种针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统在专业领域中因分布偏移导致性能下降的测试时间适应方法。TTARAG通过使模型在推理时预测检索到的内容，动态调整语言模型参数以适应目标领域，并在实验中证明了其优越性。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 测试时间适应, 领域适应, 分布偏移, 动态更新
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个名为TTARAG的测试时间适应（Test-Time Adaptation, TTA）方法，用于解决检索增强生成（RAG）系统在专业领域中因分布偏移导致的泛化性能下降问题。其核心思想是让模型学会预测检索到的内容，从而在推理时动态调整参数，这是一种相对简单但有效的方法。其重要性在于提升了RAG在特定领域应用的鲁棒性。局限性可能在于其只关注了测试时间适应，而没有探讨训练阶段的改进。

title: When Are Two Scores Better Than One? Investigating Ensembles of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models now generate high-quality, diverse samples, with an increasing focus on more powerful models. Although ensembling is a well-known way to improve supervised models, its application to unconditional score-based diffusion models remains largely unexplored. In this work we investigate whether it provides tangible benefits for generative modelling. We find that while ensembling the scores generally improves the score-matching loss and model likelihood, it fails to consistently enhance perceptual quality metrics such as FID on image datasets. We confirm this observation across a breadth of aggregation rules using Deep Ensembles, Monte Carlo Dropout, on CIFAR-10 and FFHQ. We attempt to explain this discrepancy by investigating possible explanations, such as the link between score estimation and image quality. We also look into tabular data through random forests, and find that one aggregation strategy outperforms the others. Finally, we provide theoretical insights into the summing of score models, which shed light not only on ensembling but also on several model composition techniques (e.g. guidance).

AI.title_translation: 两个分数模型何时优于一个？探究扩散模型集成
AI.tldr: 集成扩散模型在提高分数匹配损失和模型似然性方面有益，但在图像生成质量方面效果不一，尤其是在FID指标上。对于表格数据，一种集成策略表现更好。研究还提供了关于分数模型求和的理论见解。
AI.motivation: 研究扩散模型集成在无条件生成模型中的应用及其对模型性能的影响，尤其是在提高生成样本质量方面的潜力。
AI.method: 使用深度集成和蒙特卡洛 Dropout 方法，在 CIFAR-10 和 FFHQ 数据集上评估了不同聚合规则对扩散模型性能的影响。此外，还通过随机森林研究了表格数据的集成效果，并进行了理论分析。
AI.result: 集成扩散模型通常能改善分数匹配损失和模型似然性，但未能持续提高图像数据集的 FID 等感知质量指标。在表格数据上，一种特定的聚合策略优于其他策略。
AI.conclusion: 集成扩散模型在提高分数匹配损失和模型似然性方面具有潜力，但其对生成图像的感知质量的提升并不总是显著。研究为理解分数模型集成及其与指导等技术的关系提供了理论基础。
AI.translation: 扩散模型现在可以生成高质量、多样化的样本，并且人们越来越关注更强大的模型。虽然集成是改进监督模型的众所周知的方法，但将其应用于无条件基于分数的扩散模型在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们研究了它是否为生成建模提供了切实的益处。我们发现，虽然集成分数通常会改善分数匹配损失和模型似然性，但它未能持续提高图像数据集上的 FID 等感知质量指标。我们使用深度集成、蒙特卡洛 Dropout 在 CIFAR-10 和 FFHQ 上证实了这一观察结果。我们试图通过研究分数估计与图像质量之间的联系等可能的解释来解释这种差异。我们还通过随机森林研究了表格数据，并发现一种聚合策略优于其他策略。最后，我们提供了对分数模型求和的理论见解，这不仅有助于集成，还有助于几种模型组合技术（例如指导）。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了集成扩散模型在生成建模中的应用。研究发现，虽然集成通常能提高分数匹配损失和模型似然性，但对于图像生成质量（如FID指标）的提升并不一致。研究在CIFAR-10和FFHQ数据集上进行了实验，并分析了不同聚合规则的效果。此外，研究还考察了表格数据上的集成效果，并提出了分数模型求和的理论见解，为理解集成和指导等技术提供了新的视角。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 集成学习, 生成模型, 分数匹配, 图像质量
AI.comments: 该研究对扩散模型集成进行了有价值的探索，揭示了在提高模型似然性与生成样本感知质量之间可能存在的权衡。研究结果对于未来开发更有效的生成模型具有指导意义，尤其是在处理不同类型数据时。理论分析部分为理解集成机制提供了更深层次的见解。

title: IMS: Intelligent Hardware Monitoring System for Secure SoCs
comments: The final version is accepted for publication at the Design, Automation & Test in Europe Conference (DATE) 2026
summary: In the modern Systems-on-Chip (SoC), the Advanced eXtensible Interface (AXI) protocol exhibits security vulnerabilities, enabling partial or complete denial-of-service (DoS) through protocol-violation attacks. The recent countermeasures lack a dedicated real-time protocol semantic analysis and evade protocol compliance checks. This paper tackles this AXI vulnerability issue and presents an intelligent hardware monitoring system (IMS) for real-time detection of AXI protocol violations. IMS is a hardware module leveraging neural networks to achieve high detection accuracy. For model training, we perform DoS attacks through header-field manipulation and systematic malicious operations, while recording AXI transactions to build a training dataset. We then deploy a quantization-optimized neural network, achieving 98.7% detection accuracy with <=3% latency overhead, and throughput of >2.5 million inferences/s. We subsequently integrate this IMS into a RISC-V SoC as a memory-mapped IP core to monitor its AXI bus. For demonstration and initial assessment for later ASIC integration, we implemented this IMS on an AMD Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC ZCU104 board, showing an overall small hardware footprint (9.04% look-up-tables (LUTs), 0.23% DSP slices, and 0.70% flip-flops) and negligible impact on the overall design's achievable frequency. This demonstrates the feasibility of lightweight, security monitoring for resource-constrained edge environments.

AI.title_translation: 面向安全SoC的智能硬件监控系统
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为IMS的智能硬件监控系统，利用神经网络实时检测AXI协议违规攻击，以解决SoC中的安全漏洞。该系统在RISC-V SoC上进行了实现和测试，表现出高检测精度、低延迟和低硬件开销，证明了其在资源受限环境中的可行性。
AI.motivation: 现代SoC中的AXI协议存在安全漏洞，可能导致拒绝服务攻击，而现有的对策缺乏实时协议语义分析能力。
AI.method: 提出并实现了一个名为IMS的智能硬件监控系统，该系统是一个利用神经网络进行实时AXI协议违规检测的硬件模块。通过模拟DoS攻击创建训练数据集，并部署了经过量化优化的神经网络模型。该系统被集成到一个RISC-V SoC中，并在AMD Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC ZCU104开发板上进行了实现和评估。
AI.result: IMS系统实现了98.7%的检测准确率，延迟开销小于3%，吞吐量超过250万次/秒。在RISC-V SoC上的硬件资源占用率低（LUTs 9.04%，DSP切片0.23%，触发器0.70%），对整体设计频率影响可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发并验证了一个轻量级的智能硬件监控系统（IMS），能够高效地检测SoC中的AXI协议违规攻击，证明了在资源受限的边缘环境中实现安全监控的可行性。
AI.translation: 在现代片上系统（SoC）中，先进的扩展接口（AXI）协议存在安全漏洞，可能通过协议违规攻击导致部分或全部拒绝服务（DoS）。最近的对策缺乏专门的实时协议语义分析，并规避了协议合规性检查。本文解决了这一AXI漏洞问题，并提出了一种用于实时检测AXI协议违规的智能硬件监控系统（IMS）。IMS是一个利用神经网络实现高检测精度的硬件模块。为了进行模型训练，我们通过头部字段操纵和系统性的恶意操作进行DoS攻击，同时记录AXI事务以构建训练数据集。然后，我们部署了一个量化优化的神经网络，实现了98.7%的检测准确率，延迟开销小于3%，吞吐量超过250万次/秒。随后，我们将此IMS集成到RISC-V SoC中，作为内存映射的IP核来监控其AXI总线。为了进行演示和为后续ASIC集成进行初步评估，我们在AMD Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC ZCU104开发板上实现了此IMS，显示出整体硬件占用空间小（查找表（LUTs）占9.04%，DSP切片占0.23%，触发器占0.70%），并且对整个设计的可实现频率几乎没有影响。这证明了在资源受限的边缘环境中实现轻量级安全监控的可行性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为IMS的智能硬件监控系统，旨在解决SoC中AXI协议的安全漏洞问题。IMS利用神经网络进行实时检测AXI协议违规，通过模拟攻击创建训练数据，并部署了优化后的神经网络模型。实验结果表明，IMS具有高检测准确率（98.7%）、低延迟（<3%）和高吞吐量（>2.5M inferences/s）。该系统集成到RISC-V SoC后，硬件资源占用少，对性能影响微小，证明了其在资源受限环境下的安全监控潜力。
AI.keywords: 智能硬件监控系统, AXI协议, 拒绝服务攻击, 神经网络, SoC安全
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的硬件监控系统，利用神经网络解决了SoC中AXI协议的安全漏洞问题。其亮点在于实时检测能力、高准确率、低延迟和低硬件开销，这对于资源受限的边缘设备尤为重要。未来工作可以探索更复杂的攻击场景和更先进的神经网络模型以进一步提升性能。

title: PRISM-CAFO: Prior-conditioned Remote-sensing Infrastructure Segmentation and Mapping for CAFOs
summary: Large-scale livestock operations pose significant risks to human health and the environment, while also being vulnerable to threats such as infectious diseases and extreme weather events. As the number of such operations continues to grow, accurate and scalable mapping has become increasingly important. In this work, we present an infrastructure-first, explainable pipeline for identifying and characterizing Concentrated Animal Feeding Operations (CAFOs) from aerial and satellite imagery. Our method (1) detects candidate infrastructure (e.g., barns, feedlots, manure lagoons, silos) with a domain-tuned YOLOv8 detector, then derives SAM2 masks from these boxes and filters component-specific criteria, (2) extracts structured descriptors (e.g., counts, areas, orientations, and spatial relations) and fuses them with deep visual features using a lightweight spatial cross-attention classifier, and (3) outputs both CAFO type predictions and mask-level attributions that link decisions to visible infrastructure. Through comprehensive evaluation, we show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with Swin-B+PRISM-CAFO surpassing the best performing baseline by up to 15\%. AI.title_translation: 基于先验条件的集约化动物饲养场遥感基础设施分割与绘制

AI.summary: 该研究提出了PRISM-CAFO，一种用于从遥感图像中识别和绘制集约化动物饲养场（CAFOs）基础设施的流水线。它结合了YOLOv8检测、SAM2掩码生成、结构化描述符提取和空间交叉注意力分类，实现了最先进的预测性能，并提供了可解释性。

title: Implications of Grid-Forming Inverter Parameters on Disturbance Localization and Controllability
summary: The shift from traditional synchronous generator (SG) based power generation to generation driven by power electronic devices introduces new dynamic phenomena and considerations for the control of large-scale power systems. In this paper, two aspects of all-inverter power systems are investigated: greater localization of system disturbance response and greater system controllability. The prevalence of both of these aspects are shown to be related to the lower effective inertia of inverters and have implications for future widearea control system design. Greater disturbance localization implies the need for feedback measurement placement close to generator nodes to properly reject disturbances in the system while increased system controllability implies that widearea control systems should preferentially actuate inverters to most efficiently control the system. This investigation utilizes reduced-order linear time-invariant models of both SGs and inverters that are shown to capture the frequency dynamics of interest in both all-SG and all-inverter systems, allowing for the efficient use of both frequency and time domain analysis methods.

AI.title_translation: 并网逆变器参数对扰动定位和可控性的影响
AI.tldr: 并网逆变器参数影响电力系统的扰动定位和可控性，低有效惯量是关键，未来需要根据扰动和控制需求调整测量和执行器。
AI.motivation: 随着电力系统从同步发电机转向逆变器主导，需要研究逆变器参数对系统动态和控制的影响。
AI.method: 使用简化的线性时不变模型来分析同步发电机和逆变器在全逆变器系统中的频率动态。
AI.result: 发现逆变器的低有效惯量导致扰动响应的局部化和系统可控性的增强。
AI.conclusion: 逆变器参数，特别是其较低的有效惯量，对扰动响应的局部化和系统可控性有显著影响。未来的广域控制系统设计需要考虑这些因素，优化测量点的放置和执行器的选择。
AI.translation: 从传统同步发电机（SG）驱动的发电转向由电力电子设备驱动的发电，引入了新的动态现象，并需要对大规模电力系统进行控制。本文研究了全逆变器电力系统的两个方面：系统扰动响应的局部化程度和系统可控性的程度。事实证明，这两个方面普遍存在，并且与逆变器的较低有效惯量有关，并对未来的广域控制系统设计产生了影响。更大的扰动局部化意味着需要将反馈测量点放置在靠近发电机节点的位置，以便正确地抑制系统中的扰动，而更高的系统可控性意味着广域控制系统应优先作用于逆变器，以最有效地控制系统。这项研究利用了SG和逆变器的简化线性时不变模型，这些模型能够捕获全SG和全逆变器系统中感兴趣的频率动态，从而能够有效地使用频域和时域分析方法。
AI.summary: 本文研究了并网逆变器参数对全逆变器电力系统扰动响应局部化和系统可控性的影响。研究发现，逆变器较低的有效惯量是导致这些现象的关键因素。为了有效控制系统，未来的广域控制系统设计应根据扰动响应的局部化需求优化测量点的放置，并优先作用于逆变器以实现最高效的控制。
AI.keywords: 并网逆变器, 扰动定位, 可控性, 有效惯量, 广域控制
AI.comments: 该研究通过简化的线性模型有效地揭示了逆变器参数对电力系统动态的影响，为未来控制策略的设计提供了重要见解。然而，模型的简化可能忽略一些现实世界中的复杂性，未来的研究可以考虑更复杂的模型。

title: Indoor Neutral-Host Networks Over Shared Spectrum and Shared Infrastructure: A Comparison Study of Real-World Deployments
comments: Submitted to npj Wireless Technology. 21 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables
summary: Indoor high-capacity connectivity is frequently constrained by significant building penetration loss and the inherent uplink power limitations of a typical outdoor macro-cell deployment. While Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) must optimize spectrum across low-band (<1 GHz) and mid-band (1-7 GHz) frequencies, uplink performance remains disproportionately degraded due to link budget asymmetry. Neutral-host (NH) networking provides a scalable alternative by transparently offloading MNO subscribers via spectrum sharing and shared infrastructure. We present a multi-site measurement study comparing Citizens Broadband Radio Service (CBRS)-enabled NH networks against public MNO 4G/5G macro deployments and Wi-Fi. Our results show: (i) significant building penetration loss with up to 15.5 dB in low-bands and 17.9 dB in mid-bands, resulting in a ~10 dB RSRP deficit for MNO mid-bands compared to low-bands; (ii) NH networks provide a 30 dB higher median indoor RSRP with indoor NH normalized downlink throughput matches MNO outdoor performance, while its uplink performance exceeds MNO levels in both indoor and outdoor settings; (iii) NH proximity enables superior uplink efficiency, utilizing 64-QAM for 56% of transmissions (versus <6% for MNOs) and reducing median UE transmit power by 5 dB; (iv) MNOs rely on low-band spectrum for indoor uplink transmissions, while the NH deployment maintains high-performance mid-band connectivity; and (v) NH outperforms MNOs in end-to-end throughput but trails Wi-Fi in uplink throughput and latency due to packet routing overhead to the MNO core.

AI.title_translation: 室内中性主机网络在共享频谱和共享基础设施上的比较研究：真实部署的对比分析
AI.tldr: 该研究比较了支持CBRS的中性主机（NH）网络与公共移动网络运营商（MNO）的4G/5G宏基站部署和Wi-Fi在真实环境下的性能。结果表明，NH网络在室内信号强度（RSRP）和下行吞吐量方面表现优于MNO，并能匹配MNO的室外性能，其上行性能甚至超越了MNO。NH网络还能实现更高的上行链路效率，并有效利用中频段。尽管NH网络在整体吞吐量上优于MNO，但在上行吞吐量和延迟方面略逊于Wi-Fi，这主要是由于数据包路由到MNO核心网的开销。
AI.motivation: 室内部署网络容量受建筑穿透损耗和室外宏基站的上行功率限制，导致上下行链路不对称。中性主机（NH）网络通过共享频谱和基础设施为MNO提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，以应对这些挑战。
AI.method: 通过多站点实地测量，比较了基于CBRS的中性主机（NH）网络与公共MNO的4G/5G宏基站部署以及Wi-Fi在真实环境下的性能。
AI.result: （i）建筑穿透损耗显著，低频段高达15.5 dB，中频段高达17.9 dB，导致MNO中频段的RSRP比低频段低约10 dB。（ii）NH网络提供的中位数室内RSRP比MNO高30 dB，室内NH网络的归一化下行吞吐量与MNO的室外性能相当，其上行性能在室内外均优于MNO。（iii）NH网络的近距离部署提高了上行链路效率，64-QAM的传输比例高达56%（MNO低于6%），用户设备（UE）的传输功率降低了5 dB。（iv）MNO主要依靠低频段进行室内上行传输，而NH网络则保持了高性能的中频段连接。（v）NH网络在端到端吞吐量方面优于MNO，但在上行吞吐量和延迟方面略逊于Wi-Fi，原因是数据包需要通过MNO核心网进行路由。
AI.conclusion: 中性主机（NH）网络，特别是基于CBRS的部署，在应对室内连接挑战方面，如信号衰减和功率限制，展现出显著优势。它通过共享频谱和基础设施，在室内信号强度、下行吞吐量以及上行链路效率方面均优于传统的MNO宏基站部署，并能有效利用中频段。尽管在与Wi-Fi的比较中，NH网络在上行吞吐量和延迟方面存在一些不足，但其整体性能和可扩展性使其成为改善室内网络覆盖和容量的有前景的解决方案。
AI.translation: 室内高容量连接经常受到显著的建筑穿透损耗和典型室外宏基站部署的固有上行链路功率限制的制约。虽然移动网络运营商（MNO）必须优化低频段（<1 GHz）和中频段（1-7 GHz）频率的频谱，但由于链路预算不对称，上行链路性能仍然受到不成比例的损害。中性主机（NH）网络通过频谱共享和基础设施共享，透明地分载MNO用户，提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。我们提出了一个多站点测量研究，将启用CBRS的NH网络与公共MNO 4G/5G宏部署和Wi-Fi进行比较。我们的结果显示：（i）显著的建筑穿透损耗，低频段高达15.5 dB，中频段高达17.9 dB，导致MNO中频段的RSRP比低频段低约10 dB；（ii）NH网络提供高30 dB的中位数室内RSRP，室内NH归一化下行吞吐量匹配MNO室外性能，而其上行性能在室内外均优于MNO；（iii）NH的近距离部署实现了卓越的上行链路效率，64-QAM的传输比例为56%（MNO低于6%），中位数UE传输功率降低了5 dB；（iv）MNO依赖低频段进行室内上行传输，而NH部署保持了高性能的中频段连接；（v）NH在端到端吞吐量方面优于MNO，但由于到MNO核心网的路由开销，在上行吞吐量和延迟方面落后于Wi-Fi。
AI.summary: 本研究通过实地测量，对比了基于CBRS的中性主机（NH）网络与传统移动网络运营商（MNO）的4G/5G宏基站部署以及Wi-Fi在室内环境下的性能。研究发现，NH网络在室内信号强度（RSRP）和下行吞吐量方面表现优于MNO，其上行性能也超越了MNO，并能更有效地利用中频段。尽管NH网络在整体吞吐量上优于MNO，但在上行吞吐量和延迟方面与Wi-Fi相比略有不足，这归因于其数据包路由到MNO核心网的开销。
AI.keywords: 中性主机网络, CBRS, 室内覆盖, 频谱共享, 移动网络运营商
AI.comments: 该研究通过实地测量提供了宝贵的见解，量化了室内中性主机网络相对于传统MNO部署的优势，特别是在信号强度和上下行链路性能方面。研究结果强调了在应对室内连接挑战时，共享频谱和基础设施的潜力。然而，与Wi-Fi相比在延迟和上行吞吐量方面的不足，以及数据包路由开销的影响，也指出了未来需要进一步优化的方向。该研究为运营商和设备制造商在规划和部署室内无线解决方案时提供了重要的参考依据。

title: Interactive Narrative Analytics: Bridging Computational Narrative Extraction and Human Sensemaking
comments: 17 pages, 5 figures, published in IEEE Access as open access paper
summary: Information overload and misinformation create significant challenges in extracting meaningful narratives from large news collections. This paper defines the nascent field of Interactive Narrative Analytics (INA), which combines computational narrative extraction with interactive visual analytics to support sensemaking. INA approaches enable the interactive exploration of narrative structures through computational methods and visual interfaces that facilitate human interpretation. The field faces challenges in scalability, interactivity, knowledge integration, and evaluation standardization, yet offers promising opportunities across news analysis, intelligence, scientific literature exploration, and social media analysis. Through the combination of computational and human insight, INA addresses complex challenges in narrative sensemaking.

title: Learning Semantic-Geometric Task Graph-Representations from Human Demonstrations
summary: Learning structured task representations from human demonstrations is essential for understanding long-horizon manipulation behaviors, particularly in bimanual settings where action ordering, object involvement, and interaction geometry can vary significantly. A key challenge lies in jointly capturing the discrete semantic structure of tasks and the temporal evolution of object-centric geometric relations in a form that supports reasoning over task progression. In this work, we introduce a semantic-geometric task graph-representation that encodes object identities, inter-object relations, and their temporal geometric evolution from human demonstrations. Building on this formulation, we propose a learning framework that combines a Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) encoder with a Transformer-based decoder, decoupling scene representation learning from action-conditioned reasoning about task progression. The encoder operates solely on temporal scene graphs to learn structured representations, while the decoder conditions on action-context to predict future action sequences, associated objects, and object motions over extended time horizons. Through extensive evaluation on human demonstration datasets, we show that semantic-geometric task graph-representations are particularly beneficial for tasks with high action and object variability, where simpler sequence-based models struggle to capture task progression. Finally, we demonstrate that task graph representations can be transferred to a physical bimanual robot and used for online action selection, highlighting their potential as reusable task abstractions for downstream decision-making in manipulation systems.

title: MHA2MLA-VLM: Enabling DeepSeek's Economical Multi-Head Latent Attention across Vision-Language Models
summary: As vision-language models (VLMs) tackle increasingly complex and multimodal tasks, the rapid growth of Key-Value (KV) cache imposes significant memory and computational bottlenecks during inference. While Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) offers an effective means to compress the KV cache and accelerate inference, adapting existing VLMs to the MLA architecture without costly pretraining remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present MHA2MLA-VLM, a parameter-efficient and multimodal-aware framework for converting off-the-shelf VLMs to MLA. Our approach features two core techniques: (1) a modality-adaptive partial-RoPE strategy that supports both traditional and multimodal settings by selectively masking nonessential dimensions, and (2) a modality-decoupled low-rank approximation method that independently compresses the visual and textual KV spaces. Furthermore, we introduce parameter-efficient fine-tuning to minimize adaptation cost and demonstrate that minimizing output activation error, rather than parameter distance, substantially reduces performance loss. Extensive experiments on three representative VLMs show that MHA2MLA-VLM restores original model performance with minimal supervised data, significantly reduces KV cache footprint, and integrates seamlessly with KV quantization.

title: Exploring LLM Features in Predictive Process Monitoring for Small-Scale Event-Logs
summary: Predictive Process Monitoring is a branch of process mining that aims to predict the outcome of an ongoing process. Recently, it leveraged machine-and-deep learning architectures. In this paper, we extend our prior LLM-based Predictive Process Monitoring framework, which was initially focused on total time prediction via prompting. The extension consists of comprehensively evaluating its generality, semantic leverage, and reasoning mechanisms, also across multiple Key Performance Indicators. Empirical evaluations conducted on three distinct event logs and across the Key Performance Indicators of Total Time and Activity Occurrence prediction indicate that, in data-scarce settings with only 100 traces, the LLM surpasses the benchmark methods. Furthermore, the experiments also show that the LLM exploits both its embodied prior knowledge and the internal correlations among training traces. Finally, we examine the reasoning strategies employed by the model, demonstrating that the LLM does not merely replicate existing predictive methods but performs higher-order reasoning to generate the predictions.

title: Low-Rank Key Value Attention
summary:
Transformer pretraining is increasingly constrained by memory and compute requirements, with the key-value (KV) cache emerging as a dominant bottleneck during training and autoregressive decoding. We propose \textit{low-rank KV adaptation} (LRKV), a simple modification of multi-head attention that reduces KV cache memory by exploiting redundancy across attention heads while preserving full token-level resolution. Each layer uses a shared full-rank KV projection augmented with low-rank, head-specific residuals, yielding a continuous trade-off between complete sharing and fully independent attention.
  LRKV is a drop-in replacement for standard multi-head attention and directly subsumes query-sharing approaches such as multi-query and grouped-query attention, while remaining distinct from latent-compression methods such as multi-latent attention (MLA). Across large-scale pretraining experiments, LRKV consistently achieves faster loss reduction, lower validation perplexity, and stronger downstream task performance than standard attention, MQA/GQA, and MLA. At the 2.5B scale, LRKV outperforms standard attention while using roughly half the KV cache, and reaches equivalent model quality with up to \textbf{20-25\% less training compute} when measured in cumulative FLOPs. To explain these gains, we analyze attention head structure in operator space and show that LRKV preserves nearly all functional head diversity relative to standard attention, whereas more aggressive KV-sharing mechanisms rely on compensatory query specialization. Together, these results establish LRKV as a practical and effective attention mechanism for scaling Transformer pretraining under memory- and compute-constrained regimes.

title: Generative Scenario Rollouts for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging as highly effective planning models for end-to-end autonomous driving systems. However, current works mostly rely on imitation learning from sparse trajectory annotations and under-utilize their potential as generative models. We propose Generative Scenario Rollouts (GeRo), a plug-and-play framework for VLA models that jointly performs planning and generation of language-grounded future traffic scenes through an autoregressive rollout strategy. First, a VLA model is trained to encode ego vehicle and agent dynamics into latent tokens under supervision from planning, motion, and language tasks, facilitating text-aligned generation. Next, GeRo performs language-conditioned autoregressive generation. Given multi-view images, a scenario description, and ego-action questions, it generates future latent tokens and textual responses to guide long-horizon rollouts. A rollout-consistency loss stabilizes predictions using ground truth or pseudo-labels, mitigating drift and preserving text-action alignment. This design enables GeRo to perform temporally consistent, language-grounded rollouts that support long-horizon reasoning and multi-agent planning. On Bench2Drive, GeRo improves driving score and success rate by +15.7 and +26.2, respectively. By integrating reinforcement learning with generative rollouts, GeRo achieves state-of-the-art closed-loop and open-loop performance, demonstrating strong zero-shot robustness. These results highlight the promise of generative, language-conditioned reasoning as a foundation for safer and more interpretable end-to-end autonomous driving.

title: Health Facility Location in Ethiopia: Leveraging LLMs to Integrate Expert Knowledge into Algorithmic Planning
summary: Ethiopia's Ministry of Health is upgrading health posts to improve access to essential services, particularly in rural areas. Limited resources, however, require careful prioritization of which facilities to upgrade to maximize population coverage while accounting for diverse expert and stakeholder preferences. In collaboration with the Ethiopian Public Health Institute and Ministry of Health, we propose a hybrid framework that systematically integrates expert knowledge with optimization techniques. Classical optimization methods provide theoretical guarantees but require explicit, quantitative objectives, whereas stakeholder criteria are often articulated in natural language and difficult to formalize. To bridge these domains, we develop the Large language model and Extended Greedy (LEG) framework. Our framework combines a provable approximation algorithm for population coverage optimization with LLM-driven iterative refinement that incorporates human-AI alignment to ensure solutions reflect expert qualitative guidance while preserving coverage guarantees. Experiments on real-world data from three Ethiopian regions demonstrate the framework's effectiveness and its potential to inform equitable, data-driven health system planning.

title: Tensor field tomography with attenuation and refraction: adjoint operators for the dynamic case and numerical experiments
summary: This article is concerned with tensor field tomography in a fairly general setting, that takes refraction, attenuation and time-dependence of tensor fields into account. The mathematical model is given by attenuated ray transforms of the fields along geodesic curves corresponding to a Riemannian metric that is defined by the index of refraction. The data are given at the boundary tangent bundle of the domain and it is well-known that they can be characterized as boundary data of a transport equation turning tensor field tomography into an inverse source problem. This way the adjoint of the forward mapping can be computed using the integral representation or, equivalently, associated to a dual transport equation. The article offers and proves two different representations for the adjoint mappings both in the dynamic and static case. The numerical implementation is demonstrated and evaluated for static fields using the damped Landweber method with Nesterov acceleration applied to both, the integral and PDE-based formulations. The transport equations are solved using a viscosity approximation. The error analysis reveals that the integral representation significantly outperforms PDE-based methods in terms of computational efficiency while achieving comparable reconstruction accuracy. The impact of noise and deviations from straight-line trajectories are investigated confirming improved accuracy if refraction is taken into account. We conclude that the inclusion of refraction to the forward model pays in spite of increased numerical cost.

title: Space-Optimal, Computation-Optimal, Topology-Agnostic, Throughput-Scalable Causal Delivery through Hybrid Buffering
summary: Message delivery respecting causal ordering (causal delivery) is one of the most classic and widely useful abstraction for inter-process communication in a distributed system. Most approaches tag messages with causality information and buffer them at the receiver until they can be safely delivered. Except for specific approaches that exploit communication topology, therefore not generally applicable, they incur a metadata overhead which is prohibitive for a large number of processes. Much less used are the approaches that enforce causal order by buffering messages at the sender, until it is safe to release them to the network, as the classic algorithm has too many drawbacks. In this paper, first we discuss the limitations of sender-only buffering approaches and introduce the Sender Permission to Send (SPS) enforcement strategy, showing that SPS + FIFO implies Causal. We analyze a recent sender-buffering algorithm, Cykas, which follows SPS + FIFO, albeit very conservatively, pointing out throughput scalability and liveness issues. Then, we introduce a novel SPS + FIFO based algorithm, which adopts a new hybrid approach: enforcing causality by combining sender-buffering to enforce SPS and receiver-buffering to enforce FIFO. The algorithm overcomes limitations of sender-only buffering, and achieves effectively constant metadata size per message. By a careful choice of data-structures, the algorithm is also computationally-optimal, with amortized effectively constant processing overhead. As far as we know, there is no other topology-agnostic causal delivery algorithm with these properties.

title: CTest-Metric: A Unified Framework to Assess Clinical Validity of Metrics for CT Report Generation
summary: In the generative AI era, where even critical medical tasks are increasingly automated, radiology report generation (RRG) continues to rely on suboptimal metrics for quality assessment. Developing domain-specific metrics has therefore been an active area of research, yet it remains challenging due to the lack of a unified, well-defined framework to assess their robustness and applicability in clinical contexts. To address this, we present CTest-Metric, a first unified metric assessment framework with three modules determining the clinical feasibility of metrics for CT RRG. The modules test: (i) Writing Style Generalizability (WSG) via LLM-based rephrasing; (ii) Synthetic Error Injection (SEI) at graded severities; and (iii) Metrics-vs-Expert correlation (MvE) using clinician ratings on 175 "disagreement" cases. Eight widely used metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, BERTScore-F1, F1-RadGraph, RaTEScore, GREEN Score, CRG) are studied across seven LLMs built on a CT-CLIP encoder. Using our novel framework, we found that lexical NLG metrics are highly sensitive to stylistic variations; GREEN Score aligns best with expert judgments (Spearman~0.70), while CRG shows negative correlation; and BERTScore-F1 is least sensitive to factual error injection. We will release the framework, code, and allowable portion of the anonymized evaluation data (rephrased/error-injected CT reports), to facilitate reproducible benchmarking and future metric development.

title: Extractive summarization on a CMOS Ising machine
summary: Extractive summarization (ES) aims to generate a concise summary by selecting a subset of sentences from a document while maximizing relevance and minimizing redundancy. Although modern ES systems achieve high accuracy using powerful neural models, their deployment typically relies on CPU or GPU infrastructures that are energy-intensive and poorly suited for real-time inference in resource-constrained environments. In this work, we explore the feasibility of implementing McDonald-style extractive summarization on a low-power CMOS coupled oscillator-based Ising machine (COBI) that supports integer-valued, all-to-all spin couplings. We first propose a hardware-aware Ising formulation that reduces the scale imbalance between local fields and coupling terms, thereby improving robustness to coefficient quantization: this method can be applied to any problem formulation that requires k of n variables to be chosen. We then develop a complete ES pipeline including (i) stochastic rounding and iterative refinement to compensate for precision loss, and (ii) a decomposition strategy that partitions a large ES problem into smaller Ising subproblems that can be efficiently solved on COBI and later combined. Experimental results on the CNN/DailyMail dataset show that our pipeline can produce high-quality summaries using only integer-coupled Ising hardware with limited precision. COBI achieves 3-4.5x runtime speedups compared to a brute-force method, which is comparable to software Tabu search, and two to three orders of magnitude reductions in energy, while maintaining competitive summary quality. These results highlight the potential of deploying CMOS Ising solvers for real-time, low-energy text summarization on edge devices.

title: BoxMind: Closed-loop AI strategy optimization for elite boxing validated in the 2024 Olympics
summary: Competitive sports require sophisticated tactical analysis, yet combat disciplines like boxing remain underdeveloped in AI-driven analytics due to the complexity of action dynamics and the lack of structured tactical representations. To address this, we present BoxMind, a closed-loop AI expert system validated in elite boxing competition. By defining atomic punch events with precise temporal boundaries and spatial and technical attributes, we parse match footage into 18 hierarchical technical-tactical indicators. We then propose a graph-based predictive model that fuses these explicit technical-tactical profiles with learnable, time-variant latent embeddings to capture the dynamics of boxer matchups. Modeling match outcome as a differentiable function of technical-tactical indicators, we turn winning probability gradients into executable tactical adjustments. Experiments show that the outcome prediction model achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 69.8% accuracy on BoxerGraph test set and 87.5% on Olympic matches. Using this predictive model as a foundation, the system generates strategic recommendations that demonstrate proficiency comparable to human experts. BoxMind is validated through a closed-loop deployment during the 2024 Paris Olympics, directly contributing to the Chinese National Team's historic achievement of three gold and two silver medals. BoxMind establishes a replicable paradigm for transforming unstructured video data into strategic intelligence, bridging the gap between computer vision and decision support in competitive sports.

title: Efficient error estimators for Generalized Nyström
summary: Randomized algorithms in numerical linear algebra have proven to be effective in ameliorating issues of scalability when working with large matrices, efficiently producing accurate low-rank approximations. A key remaining challenge, however, is to efficiently assess the approximation accuracy of randomized methods without additional expensive matrix accesses. Recent work has addressed this issue by deriving fast leave-one-out error estimators for the randomized SVD and Nyström decomposition, enabling accurate error estimation with no additional matrix accesses. In this work, we extend the leave-one-out framework to the generalized Nyström decomposition, an approach that can be applied to general rectangular matrices. We do this by deriving three new leave-one-out error estimators and validating their effectiveness through numerical experiments.

title: The Poisoned Apple Effect: Strategic Manipulation of Mediated Markets via Technology Expansion of AI Agents
summary: The integration of AI agents into economic markets fundamentally alters the landscape of strategic interaction. We investigate the economic implications of expanding the set of available technologies in three canonical game-theoretic settings: bargaining (resource division), negotiation (asymmetric information trade), and persuasion (strategic information transmission). We find that simply increasing the choice of AI delegates can drastically shift equilibrium payoffs and regulatory outcomes, often creating incentives for regulators to proactively develop and release technologies. Conversely, we identify a strategic phenomenon termed the "Poisoned Apple" effect: an agent may release a new technology, which neither they nor their opponent ultimately uses, solely to manipulate the regulator's choice of market design in their favor. This strategic release improves the releaser's welfare at the expense of their opponent and the regulator's fairness objectives. Our findings demonstrate that static regulatory frameworks are vulnerable to manipulation via technology expansion, necessitating dynamic market designs that adapt to the evolving landscape of AI capabilities.

title: Convergence Properties of Good Quantum Codes for Classical Communication
summary: An important part of the information theory folklore had been about the output statistics of codes that achieve the capacity and how the empirical distributions compare to the output distributions induced by the optimal input in the channel capacity problem. Results for a variety of such empirical output distributions of good codes have been known in the literature, such as the comparison of the output distribution of the code to the optimal output distribution in vanishing and non-vanishing error probability cases. Motivated by these, we aim to achieve similar results for the quantum codes that are used for classical communication, that is the setting in which the classical messages are communicated through quantum codewords that pass through a noisy quantum channel. We first show the uniqueness of the optimal output distribution, to be able to talk more concretely about the optimal output distribution. Then, we extend the vanishing error probability results to the quantum case, by using techniques that are close in spirit to the classical case. We also extend non-vanishing error probability results to the quantum case on block codes, by using the second-order converses for such codes based on hypercontractivity results for the quantum generalized depolarizing semi-groups.

title: On the Probability of First Success in Differential Evolution: Hazard Identities and Tail Bounds
comments: All codes are publically available at https://github.com/snenovgmailcom/lshade_hazard_project
summary:
We study first-hitting times in Differential Evolution (DE) through a conditional hazard frame work. Instead of analyzing convergence via Markov-chain transition kernels or drift arguments, we ex press the survival probability of a measurable target set $A$ as a product of conditional first-hit probabilities (hazards) $p_t=\Prob(E_t\mid\mathcal F_{t-1})$. This yields distribution-free identities for survival and explicit tail bounds whenever deterministic lower bounds on the hazard hold on the survival event.
  For the L-SHADE algorithm with current-to-$p$best/1 mutation, we construct a checkable algorithmic witness event $\mathcal L_t$ under which the conditional hazard admits an explicit lower bound depending only on sampling rules, population size, and crossover statistics. This separates theoretical constants from empirical event frequencies and explains why worst-case constant-hazard bounds are typically conservative.
  We complement the theory with a Kaplan--Meier survival analysis on the CEC2017 benchmark suite . Across functions and budgets, we identify three distinct empirical regimes: (i) strongly clustered success, where hitting times concentrate in short bursts; (ii) approximately geometric tails, where a constant-hazard model is accurate; and (iii) intractable cases with no observed hits within the evaluation horizon. The results show that while constant-hazard bounds provide valid tail envelopes, the practical behavior of L-SHADE is governed by burst-like transitions rather than homogeneous per-generati on success probabilities.

title: QUPID: A Partitioned Quantum Neural Network for Anomaly Detection in Smart Grid
summary: Smart grid infrastructures have revolutionized energy distribution, but their day-to-day operations require robust anomaly detection methods to counter risks associated with cyber-physical threats and system faults potentially caused by natural disasters, equipment malfunctions, and cyber attacks. Conventional machine learning (ML) models are effective in several domains, yet they struggle to represent the complexities observed in smart grid systems. Furthermore, traditional ML models are highly susceptible to adversarial manipulations, making them increasingly unreliable for real-world deployment. Quantum ML (QML) provides a unique advantage, utilizing quantum-enhanced feature representations to model the intricacies of the high-dimensional nature of smart grid systems while demonstrating greater resilience to adversarial manipulation. In this work, we propose QUPID, a partitioned quantum neural network (PQNN) that outperforms traditional state-of-the-art ML models in anomaly detection. We extend our model to R-QUPID that even maintains its performance when including differential privacy (DP) for enhanced robustness. Moreover, our partitioning framework addresses a significant scalability problem in QML by efficiently distributing computational workloads, making quantum-enhanced anomaly detection practical in large-scale smart grid environments. Our experimental results across various scenarios exemplifies the efficacy of QUPID and R-QUPID to significantly improve anomaly detection capabilities and robustness compared to traditional ML approaches.

title: Coding Schemes for the Noisy Torn Paper Channel
summary: To make DNA a suitable medium for archival data storage, it is essential to consider the decay process of the strands observed in DNA storage systems. This paper studies the decay process as a probabilistic noisy torn paper channel (TPC), which first corrupts the bits of the transmitted sequence in a probabilistic manner by substitutions, then breaks the sequence into a set of noisy unordered substrings. The present work devises coding schemes for the noisy TPC by embedding markers in the transmitted sequence. We investigate the use of static markers and markers connected to the data in the form of hash functions. These two tools have also been recently exploited to tackle the noiseless TPC. Simulations show that static markers excel at higher substitution probabilities, while data-dependent markers are superior at lower noise levels. Both approaches achieve reconstruction rates exceeding $99\%$ with no false decodings observed, primarily limited by computational resources.

title: MetaboNet: The Largest Publicly Available Consolidated Dataset for Type 1 Diabetes Management
comments: 22 pages, 5 figures, 7 supplementary figures, submitted to JDST
summary: Progress in Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) algorithm development is limited by the fragmentation and lack of standardization across existing T1D management datasets. Current datasets differ substantially in structure and are time-consuming to access and process, which impedes data integration and reduces the comparability and generalizability of algorithmic developments. This work aims to establish a unified and accessible data resource for T1D algorithm development. Multiple publicly available T1D datasets were consolidated into a unified resource, termed the MetaboNet dataset. Inclusion required the availability of both continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data and corresponding insulin pump dosing records. Additionally, auxiliary information such as reported carbohydrate intake and physical activity was retained when present. The MetaboNet dataset comprises 3135 subjects and 1228 patient-years of overlapping CGM and insulin data, making it substantially larger than existing standalone benchmark datasets. The resource is distributed as a fully public subset available for immediate download at https://metabo-net.org/ , and with a Data Use Agreement (DUA)-restricted subset accessible through their respective application processes. For the datasets in the latter subset, processing pipelines are provided to automatically convert the data into the standardized MetaboNet format. A consolidated public dataset for T1D research is presented, and the access pathways for both its unrestricted and DUA-governed components are described. The resulting dataset covers a broad range of glycemic profiles and demographics and thus can yield more generalizable algorithmic performance than individual datasets.
